description: This PHP script handles user registration, password validation, and administrative notifications for a web application, specifically managing the first login or sign-up process. It includes logic for configuration checks, form handling, user creation and updates, email validation, and notification email dispatch to administrators.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: A class representing a user in the system, providing methods for password validation, updating user data, and checking password management method.

classes.name: tlRole
classes.description: A class managing user roles, providing methods to retrieve users associated with specific roles.

classes.name: database
classes.description: Constants or class for database connection options, used in doDBConnect.

classes.name: tlObject
classes.description: Utility class for database table retrieval.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves user input arguments from POST and GET requests, returning them in a structured object.

methods.name: notifyGlobalAdmins
methods.description: Sends notification emails to system administrators or specified users about new user sign-up events.
